_notes: dest_rel_path is resolved against provision.py --root (reference host uses /opt/forge, so models land at /opt/forge/models/<family>/<model>/<file>).
null sha256/size_bytes = unknown, to be pinned after first verified download. null hf_repo or filename = TBD upstream; provisioner reports these as PENDING and skips them.
gguf:true entries are additionally checked for the 'GGUF' magic bytes.
type:"service" entries have no files — they are deployed separately (systemd unit / external install).

models.notes: Default brain model (Gemma 4 E4B QAT). Exact upstream HF repo + filename TBD — placeholder filename until pinned.
STT server model (forge-stt.service). Upstream repo TBD.
Qwen3-TTS talker + codec pair (forge-tts-base.service). Reference host keeps these under qwentts.cpp/models; mirrored into the models/ layout here.
Forced aligner word-timestamp endpoint (forge-aligner.service, port 8086). Repo/filename TBD; gguf:false pending confirmation.

variants.mtp: includes the release's tuned draft head mtp-gemma-4-26B-A4B-it.gguf (used with --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 4 --swa-full)

variants.rocm: ROCm-target build variant of the same weights
variants.vulkan: Vulkan-target build variant of the same weights

models.notes: Placeholder entry — exact upstream identity TBD.
ComfyUI runs as a service (forge-comfyui.service / remote PairNode node), not a downloaded asset.
